title: Unify mobile Gallery qualification orchestration
requires: Any development host; Android and iOS build CI
scope: Move scripted mobile scene, control and lifecycle qualification orchestration and its report schema into common Gallery support while platform runners provide surfaces and OS lifecycle events.
acceptance: Android and iOS qualification runners invoke one common scenario model and emit the same versioned report fields for scenes, controls, lifecycle, renderer and failures.
Common contract tests cover attach, resize, background, recovery, control execution and scene selection without duplicating that sequence in platform shells.
